name: Waypoint
description: Plotted points: a ring with a bar dropped from it, the way a fix is marked on the chart.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; top: 8%; width: 52%; height: 52%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 58%; width: 8%; height: 34%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
